title: Ukrposhta: war is changing shopping habits
summary: Ukrposhta, together with Kasta, has launched Ukrposhta Market - a new way to shop for everyday essentials directly in the Ukrposhta 2.0 app, with free delivery to any Ukrposhta post office across Ukraine.

title: Car carrier orderbook surge raises oversupply fears
summary:
The orderbook for pure car and truck carriers (PCTCs) has surged amid booming Chinese vehicle exports and elevated charter earnings, raising concerns that an expanding fleet could outpace demand as European restrictions on Chinese vehicle imports threaten to curb a key source of cargo growth.
Greek brokerage Intermodal said last week that 82 PCTCs were contracted in the first nine months of 2026, compared with just nine vessels ordered throughout 2025 ...
